description:
Both `firefox-smoke` and `webkit-smoke` jobs in
`.github/workflows/results-explorer-browser.yml` run with
`continue-on-error: true`, making them advisory-only. This item
flips each to a blocking gate once it demonstrates sufficient CI
stability.

WebKit: the DuckDB-WASM init race was fixed in
`stabilize-webkit-browser-smoke-flake-under-parallel-workers` (w2) by
serializing workers. Gate is 10 consecutive green CI runs post-fix.

Firefox: no known active flake. Gate is the same 10-consecutive-green
criterion applied independently - Firefox may be ready before WebKit
if it is already passing consistently.

Each browser is flipped independently; do not wait for both before
promoting one.

anti_patterns.dont: flip both browsers in a single commit if their thresholds are reached at different times
anti_patterns.instead: flip each in its own commit.
anti_patterns.why: batching obscures which browser caused any subsequent regression

anti_patterns.dont: flip on a calendar or release schedule
anti_patterns.why: promoting before the run is stable will make the gate unreliable and erode trust in CI

item_meta.blocked_reason: Two defects found 2026-08-03. First, both verification rungs query repo joeharris76/benchbox-private, but this project is joeharris76/BenchBox, so the rungs do not evaluate the real WebKit and Firefox job history. Second, the must-preserve 'The Chromium blocking gate is unaffected' rests on a false premise: Chromium is not a gate at all. The develop ruleset develop-squash-only (15611785) requires only ci-required-result, and results-explorer-browser.yml has no develop push trigger, so its runs never gate a merge. Sequence after explorer-chromium-gate-actually-blocking-20260803-v3, which establishes a real Chromium gate first. Rungs are create-time-only, so this item needs recreation rather than editing.

preserves.behavior: Each browser is assessed independently - do not block one promotion on the other.
The Chromium blocking gate is unaffected by either change.

verifications.command: gh run list --workflow=results-explorer-browser.yml --repo joeharris76/benchbox-private --limit=15 --json databaseId | jq -r '.[].databaseId' | xargs -I{} gh api repos/joeharris76/benchbox-private/actions/runs/{}/jobs --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name=="WebKit (@smoke, non-blocking)") | .conclusion' | head -10
verifications.description: Last 10 WebKit job conclusions are all success

verifications.command: gh run list --workflow=results-explorer-browser.yml --repo joeharris76/benchbox-private --limit=15 --json databaseId | jq -r '.[].databaseId' | xargs -I{} gh api repos/joeharris76/benchbox-private/actions/runs/{}/jobs --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name=="Firefox (@smoke, non-blocking)") | .conclusion' | head -10
verifications.description: Last 10 Firefox job conclusions are all success

work_units.notes:
Check the last 10 WebKit job conclusions:
  gh run list --workflow=results-explorer-browser.yml --repo joeharris76/benchbox-private \
    --limit=15 --json databaseId \
    | jq -r '.[].databaseId' \
    | xargs -I{} gh api repos/joeharris76/benchbox-private/actions/runs/{}/jobs \
        --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name=="WebKit (@smoke, non-blocking)") | .conclusion' \
    | head -10
Once all 10 lines are "success", remove `continue-on-error: true` from
the `webkit-smoke` job block in `.github/workflows/results-explorer-browser.yml`.
work_units.summary: Flip webkit-smoke to a blocking gate after 10 consecutive CI green runs
